title: Merge 2 specialised systems: q01, q19
summary: I merged the q01 and q19 specialised systems. Both patches were already in the working tree with no conflicts, so I made no new source edits. The release build succeeded. Quick bench against the current best: q01 went from 322.1 to 286.2 ms (-11.1%), q19 from 300.3 to 157.6 ms (-47.5%), and the geomean is -31.7%. That was the quick check (2 bindings per template, 4 hot runs each), and both gains are well above its ~5% noise level.
notes: The two patches touch separate files (aggregation code vs optimizer and scan filter), so they could not interfere, and the bench shows no cross-template slowdown.
